div.p: University College Dublin, MS Franciscan A 4, Acallam na Senórach, pp. 35–46. Corresponding to Stokes, ‘Acallamh na Senórach’, ll. 2,390–3,520.
Semi-diplomatic edition by Nina Cnockaert-Guillou, 17 December 2025
IS annsin ro fīarfaig Eochaid Lethderg rí Laigen do Caílte:

‘Crēd fodera d’Find
can in pēst adbalmór atā acaindi a nGlend Ruis Enaigh thes do marbad seoch cech n-arracht ele ro dīchuir a hÉrind?’.

‘IS ed fodera sin’, ar Oisīn, ‘in cetramad mír d’incind Mess Geghra hí ⁊ ro sluic in talam ann hí co ndernad pēst adbulmōr di ⁊ ní raibi a ndán di duine da marbad’, ar Oisīn, ‘no co tísad Tāilgend do muintir in clērigh sea atā arin cnuc ⁊ descipul dó hé ⁊ do muintir Rí Nime ⁊ Talman é ⁊ co dísad sē re deired na imsiri ⁊ co tí in brāth adbulmōr do mes ar bííb ⁊ ar marbaib’.
‘Cidh fodera’, ar rí Érenn ‘ar feraib ⁊ ar conaib na fēindi cen dul do marbad na pīasta arin loch sin?’.

‘Lendán sídhi ro bái oc Find’, ar Oisīn, ‘.i. Ūaine ingen Moghdhuirnd ⁊ tuc Find éra tochmairc uirri ara méd d’illrechtaib a tēighed sí ūair ní raibi bethadhach nach tēighed sī ’na richt ⁊ tāncatar an fīann laithe n-ōen arin carnd os cind an locha ⁊ táinic an fīadh amach arin loch ⁊ ro marbust in pēist dā cét óglach uaind ⁊ dā cét cú ⁊ ro fīarfaig Caílte annsin aroisin d’Find:
“Cid duit-siu cen a fis dūindi in lind tuites in pēst úd ⁊ dā mad lind ro tuitfed sí co cuirimais ria ⁊ co ndīghlamais ar muintir uirri?”.
⁊ tuc Find a ordain fa déd fis ⁊ ro foillsiged fīr fāistine dó ⁊ ro ceiled gæ fair ann ⁊ it-bert:
bid bind guth cluicc ann biaid tan
ar dā cét déc sēt sairthi
is ē is āille it-condarc rīam
bid adnacht rīgh cenn a cenn

Ní fuil ārim ⁊ ní fétir a faisnés ⁊ ní toillend an uimir in neoch ro indsedar do dēnam dōib fēin do gnīmaib gaile ⁊ gaisced ⁊ do maithib fīand Érend re tǣb dindsencais cecha cnuic ⁊ cecha forba ⁊ cecha feraind ro fīarfaigetar .ú. ollcúicid Érend uile dīb.

IS andsin táinig Tamun Trēntrebair mac Tréin .i. flathbrugaid cétach comrumach do rí Érend trī .l. fer mór ⁊ tuigi maīle forro ⁊ faitiurān fīrgorm im cech fer dīb ⁊ fedāna finduma isna brataib ōsa mbruindib ⁊ lenti līcda lāngela umpu ⁊ trī .l. gabal ina lāmaib ⁊ ro bennachadar do rí Érend ⁊ frecras in rí īat:
‘Do fil fledh mōrcaīn mōradbul acaind duit’.
.i. xxx. dabach do midh ⁊ .xxx. dabach do brogóid cona lōrdōthain do biud leo ⁊ tucsat an biad ⁊ in lind do rí Érend ⁊ tāncatar dā tighib ara cūlaib.
‘Maith a anam a Oisīn’, ar rí Érend, ‘in tech n-óla ar leith bias acut-sa ⁊ acut comdalta .i. ac Caílte nō ’na n-éininad ré maithib fer nÉrend rachai?’.
‘Ar cuid bidh ⁊ lenda dūind ar leith’, ar Oisīn, ‘ūair ní lucht comdíne nā comaimsire dūind na daine atā in Érind innosa’, ar Oisīn.
‘Dā nōnbur’, ar Oisīn, ‘.i. ix. dam-sa ⁊ .ix. dom’ comdalta’.
‘.i. do .c. xx. dabach do mídh ⁊ do lind dīb’, ar rī Érend.
‘Maith a anam a airdrī’, ar Caílte, ‘nā cutrumaigh-siu sind do biud nā do lind caidchi ūair in tan do-bértha-sa .x. ndabcha dam-sa .x. ndabcha .xx. bud cōir do tobairt d’Oisīn’.

⁊ ro bātar re hed na haidhchi sin and co táinic lá cona lán soillsi cen uiresbaid bid nā lenda orra ⁊ ba cres a pupall tar rí Érend isin tulaigh tond glais ⁊ tāinic Pātraic cona clérchib isin dara leth don pupuill ⁊ táinic rí Érend isin leth ele ⁊ nír lēiced acht rīgh nō dam…na
rig…c…s…cid isin ūt a raibi rí Ērend ⁊ nír lēiced acht espoc nō sacart nó mac óighi do Rí Nime ⁊ Talman isin leth i raibi Pātraic don pupuill ⁊ suidhis Oisīn a fīaghnaisi Pātraic ⁊ suidis Caílte a fīaghnaisi rīgh Érend.
‘Cīa agaib is sine itruibh, a Oisīn’, ar rí Érend, ‘.i. tusa nō Caílte?’
‘Is sine misi’, ar Caílte, ‘ūair .x. mblīadna .xx. ro ba slán dam-sa a n-ūair rucad Oisīn ⁊ secht mblīadna déc dó im’ lepad-si ⁊ is as mo thigh ro gab féind ⁊ foirend’.
IS andsin ro fīarfaig rí Érend dīb-siun:
‘Cā lín rí do rīgaib Érend leis a tucad ferand con féind ⁊ cā rīg fēindigh da tucad?’
⁊ frecrus Caílte co comnart in cest sin ūair ro bí a fis aige:

‘Ardrī ro gabustar rīgi nÉrend dar ba comainm Feradach Fechtnach ⁊ bātar dā mac maithi aici .i. Tūathal ⁊ Fīachu in anmanda ⁊ fūair rí Érend bás .i. Feradach Fechtnach ⁊ ro roindset a dā mac Érind etarru .i. a seōit ⁊ a maīne ⁊ a hindmusa a brat ⁊ a būar ⁊ a bó táinti a failgi ⁊ a fornasga a dúin ⁊ a dingnada ⁊ a deghbaileda don dara fir. A halla ⁊ a hindbera a mes ⁊ a torad ⁊ a hecneda āilli eocharbrecca ⁊ a tuirc tāebtroma ⁊ a heilti rūaga rōremra ⁊ a daim imdīsciri alltaidi don fir ele’.
‘Cāit a ndernsat in roind sin?’ ar rí Érend.
‘Arin cnuc sa itám inar suidhi do rindset in roind ūd’, ar Caílte.
‘Nī hinand in roind sin itir’, ar maithi fer nÉrend.
‘Cā roind dīb is ferr lib-si?’ ar Oisīn, ‘.i. a fleda ⁊ a tāirci ⁊ a tighi isin cét roind dīb? A fedha ⁊ a fāsaighi a selg ⁊ a fīadhach ⁊ a fīand coscur isin roind ele?’
‘In roind roba mesa dīb’, ar Caílte, ‘dar lib-si is ī rob ferr lindi dīb’, ar Caílte.
‘INdis d’feraib Érend súd a anum a Caílte’, ar Oisīn.
1. Ráidh a Caīlti cid dīa fuil
do gab an féind a hUisnech.
in abraid rim co ro ceill
cīa do sgar re gillacht con
3. Mebair lim in ní da fuil
ō ro lesaigh Fīachu an féind
ō ros bréc Fathadh an féind
ro bī in righan a máthuir.
ro indset Érind cind a cind
7. Ruc do roga in mac ba só
a fleda a tāircthi a tighi
cor toit le Mál in mac flaith
bás in rīgh in aidchi sin.
10. Luid Fīachu i Temair co mblad
11. Īar sin do rat Fīachu an féind
15. Cas mac Candain crūaid a nim
19. Ro gab Cumall crūaidh a nim
20. Ro gab Cumall crūaid a nim
im Daigri im Goll im Garadh.
22. Goll mór fa mílid a cath
23. ĪAR sin do gab int eó óir
24. Ar flaith ar séghaind ar saí
ar mbreithem ar ndrūth ar ndraí
ar cend cumaing ar slicht slóigh
25. Dob é Find in cóiciud lǣch
sǣgal Find ba fada a ré
27. Secht rīgh déc lān mebair lem
is ferr do cuala can acht
29. Ba dīb Badhgna a Sīd Badgna
Mogh Ruith is Find a Formáil.
Find fēin ūa Baīscne barr gloin.
34. Cōicer is gaithi im cēill ngrind
ro buí a n-ēntigh i nÉrind
in ceist do-níth Find na fled
37. Lug mac Cēin meic Cainti anall
Find fēin ūa Baīscne barr glain.
bud ferr im lind is im bīad
Cú na cerda crūaid a báidh
Find is Mac Luchta ar æncái.
40. Cōicer flatha is ferr di lem
dar in rí uil ōs mo chind
acht girra a sægail cech tan
45. Ferr a sreth inā cech sreth
mēd na fer is méd na scīath
mēd na lǣch ngasta ngairg líath.
46. Ba rí ba fáidh ba filid
ar fisigh ar ndrai ar fáidh
ba bind lind cech ní ro rāid. Ráid.
dar in rí uil ōs mo chinn
cid maith ō mbél ní do rád. Ráid.
48. Co fa shecht do creid in rí
in sechtmad fecht ro bí ar ás
49. Leth Mogha ic Eoghan ro baī
trénmór is re lāim ro lái
ba bind leis cech ní ro ráidh. Rāidh’.

‘Adrae búaid ⁊ bennachtain a anum a Caīlte’, ar Dīarmaid mac Cerbaill, ‘⁊ cāit a fuilet sin ⁊ senchaidi fer nÉrend? Scribtar lib i tāmlorgaib filed ⁊ i mbrīathraib ollaman sūd ⁊ bered cách a cuid leis dā crīch ⁊ da ferand fēin de’.
⁊ do scribad oca n-ugdaraib ⁊ oca filedaib ⁊ oca n-ollamnaib in scélaighecht sin ⁊ ruc cách a cuid cum a crīchi ⁊ a coigid leis di.
IS andsin ro fīarfaig Find mac Fæbair meic rīg Ō Cinnselaigh:
‘Maith a anam a Caīlte’, ar sē, ‘crēd fadera díth selga isin giúsaigh find?’, ar sē.

‘Næim ⁊ fīrēoin ac adhradh dhi sech cech inad ele isin crīch ⁊ lubgort selga d’Find í’, ar Oisīn, ‘⁊ in tráth nā faghdais an fīand a cuicid lāimdeirg Laigen ō Muigh Febin co Bein Étair an dōthain selga do gebdis isin giusaigh sin find’.
‘Maith a anum’, ar Find mac Fæbair, ‘créd ’ma n-abar Áth Fernda risin áth athā ar lār na giūsaighi?’.
Fregras Oisīn in ceist sin ūair ro buí a fis aigi .i.

‘Goll mac Mornda ro marbustar Fernd mac Cairill ar foghail mac Mornda ⁊ mac rīgh na nDēisi hé ⁊ ōclach grāda d’Find é ⁊ oca chur fa fochluidib talman, tuc Find a ordain fa dét fis ⁊ ro foillsiged fírindi dó ⁊ ro ceiled goí fair ⁊ it-bert:

“Dar mo brēithir am”, ar sé, “a Fernda
meic Cairill, is mogénar do handlaiced isin inad-sa ūair is mōr do findceōlānaib celebraid ⁊ do findlebraib aifrind ⁊ do idpairt cuirp in coimded ⁊ in dūileman do dēntar and”.
⁊ ro baī ic tairngire Mædóc ann ⁊ it-bert:
6. Bid é an torc trén tulchaighi
bidh í in lasair borr brātha
bidh í in tond tar ilar n-átha. Āth”’.
‘IS maith ro indisis sin, a Caílte’, ar Find mac Fæbair, ‘⁊ atā ceist ele is āil lium d’fīarfaigid dit’.

‘Baile atā againdi a coicrīch in dā cōiced .i. comur ollbladach na trī n-uisci, āit a comraicend Siúir ⁊ Beoir ⁊ Berba a n-ēninad ⁊ Ros mBrocc ainm an baile sin. ⁊ rob āil lium a fis ūait-siu cīa aca raibi in dūnad ⁊ in degbaile úd and’.

‘Urusa lium-sa a fis sin duit’, ar Caīlte, ‘.i. dā óclach grāda d’Find ro baī and .i. Cellach Brænbile ⁊ Moling Lūath do cūiced Gaileon ⁊ do bātar dá .c. ōclach ⁊ dā .c. gilla ⁊ dā .c. cú cechtar díb’.
‘⁊ cid īat trī catha na fēindi do shirthea?’.
‘Ní raibi and dīas bud ferr lūth na lāmach i n-āit sin ⁊ ro baī maithius oile intib maráen risin, ūair isna tighib ro baī an fīand re blíadain centacha bid na lenda orra risin’.
‘INgnad lind’, ar Find mac Fæbair, ‘uisci an baile sin ína ard ⁊ a sruth ina
all ⁊ cech æn bīs a ngalar ⁊ a n-eslāinti, īcaid uisci an baile sin é co rob slemain slāncrēchtach da éis’.
‘An fetraisi a adbar sin, a Find maic Fæbair?’ ar Caílte.

‘As é sin cétuisci ro bendacatar aingil an duileman a nÉrinn ⁊ is é uisci deighenach bendeochar inti é ⁊ Taidíu ainm in uisci ⁊ na haband. ⁊ do bátar in dā óclach sin and no co ndechatar maic Mornda ar fogail ⁊ ar dīberg ō Find ⁊ nír rathaighed īat and no cor gabsat anair ⁊ aníar, andess ⁊ atūaigh imonn baile. ⁊ ro bātar re teōra lā ⁊ re teōra aidchi ac cur risin mbaile ⁊ nír fétsat ní dó risin ⁊ in tres trát fūaradar bǣgal tened do cur isin mbaile ⁊ do loisced leo hé ⁊ do rigned a argain leó, cona tērnógh fer indisti scél nā tuillti tūarustail as cen loscud. ⁊ in trāt tairrnic leo in baile do loscud, tāncatar rompu tar scairb Indbir Dubglaisi ⁊ tar Berba bithglais sīar ⁊ in trāt rāncatar tar Berba siar,
is and rāncamair-ne trī catha na fēindi cum an dūnaid cincur cobair dōib-sin sin ⁊ suidhis Find ac féchain an baile tre thenidh ⁊ ro suighset trī catha na fēindi uime and ⁊ ro cáithset co dīchra, ūair ní dernad riú riam reme na nadegad gnim bud doilgid leó in aingnīm sin. ⁊ tucad longsīthal bānóir docum na flatha Find ⁊ ro indail a lāma ⁊ ro cuir uisci ūaine eochargorm ima gnúis rīgda romōir roisclethain ⁊ fan rosc nglas ngāirechtach ⁊ tuc a ordain fa dét fis ⁊ in tres fírindi is mō ro faillsiged dō riam is andsan ūair sin ro faillsiged dó é.

“Cetri fáidhe toghaidi ticfait tarmeisi-sea in Érind ⁊ do Rí Nime ⁊ Talman do dēnait a fāistine ⁊ bud andso ticfa in cetrama fer dīb .i. Moling mac Fælāin meic Feradaigh Find ⁊ cath cuirfidhter re deired n-aimsiri a nÉrind .i. Cath Muighi Rath. ⁊ Suibne Geilt tic asin cath, is andsa baile sea muirbfighter ⁊ adlaicfidter é ⁊ ben d’feraib Muman matair in clérigh. ⁊ ní lēmaid fir Muman olc do dēnam don baile caidhci’.
cid cīan gairit no co tí
ar ūr, cairrgi, cloch is lía
beith ara greis bud maith lim
sæth lim mé fēin can beith ind.
forba a slūaigh co Tech Moling
ō sin amach co brāth mend
‘Maith, a anum, a Find meic Fæbair’, ar Cailti, ‘is ī sin in ceist ro fīarfaigis dim’.
IS andsin a-dubairt rí Érend re Pātraic:
‘Is mithid lium-sa dul do Temair na Rīgh budesta, ⁊ in tectai-si lim, a senōracha’, ar Dīarmait, ‘don dula-sa?’.
‘Ní racum’, ar sīat, ‘co mā slān ar mblīadain’.
IS andsin a-dubairt Eochaid lethderg rí Laigen:
‘Bērat-sa lium, Oisīn’, ar sē, ‘risin mblīadain-sea, co Dūn Lemna Lendcaime ingine Dobrain Dubtaire’.
‘Bērat-sa, Cailti, lim’, ar Conall mōr mac Nēill, ‘co cun na mBarc risin mblīadain-sea’.
‘Bērat-sa noem Pātraic lium’, ar Dīarmait mac Cerbaill, ‘risin mblīadain-sea co Temair do baisted ⁊ do bennachad fer nÉrend ina cirt ⁊ ina rīaghlaib bodēin’.

⁊ ro scáilset
fir Érend ar sin dā crīch ⁊ dā forba bodēin co ro comraicset fir Érend a Temair tæbglais taitnemaigh toghaidi a cind blīadna doríse. Gurob í Imagallaim na Senōrach ⁊ cech ar’ cansat d’fis ⁊ d’eólus d’feraib Érend uile a cin cairthi a mullach Uisnigh conici sin.

Dála Caīlte, táinic sin maræn re Conall mac Nēill co Rait Artraigh i Cenél Conaill. IS annsin ro ērgetar ingena míne macdachta ⁊ meic becca bratūaine ⁊ amais ⁊ ōclaigh ⁊ ro fersat uile fāilti fria Caīlte ⁊ bātar ac ól ⁊ ac āibnius fria hed na haidci sin no cor érigh grīan asa circaill truim tenntighi cor soillsigh alla ⁊ essa ⁊ indbera an talman.
INa degaid sin táinic Conall co maithib a muintiri ⁊ Caílte arin fert fotmuighi baī ar inchaib an baile ⁊ fīarfaigis Conall do Caílte:
‘Cid ’ma tucad Rāith Artrach arin rāith sea thūaidh ⁊ crēd ma tucad Lís na nĒiges arin lis sa rind andes ⁊ crēd ’ma tucad Rāith Mongaigh arin rāith sea tūaidh?’.
‘Trī meic ro bātar ic Bodb Derg mac in Dagda isin Brugh breccsolus .i. Artrach ⁊ Æd Ālaind ⁊ Ængus. IS andsin do rala imresan ⁊ imorrān etturru ⁊ in athair.

“Maith a anum, a macu”, ar Bodb Derg, “fácaidh-si dam-sa .t.d.danann ⁊ imtighid cum rīgh Érend .i. cum Cormac úa Cuinn ⁊ fuilet adbair ’mana cōir díb .t.d.d. d’fácbail, ūair nocan fuil do maithius maínech mōradbul ic .t.d.d. urdail a fuil acaib-si.Ūair ní fuil d’ferand ic .t.d.d. fulang a fuil do maithius ic Artrach. ⁊ is lía do muinter ac Oengus inā do .t.d.d. uili iter gilla ⁊ ōclach. ⁊ is līa do Æd Ālaind na n-éices inā do clíaraib Érend ⁊ Alpan”.
⁊ ársin tancatar na trī meic sin cuínn rīgh Érend.
“Crēd ’ma tāncabair, a ógu?” bar rí Ērend.
“Ar n-athair fēin”, ar sīat, “.i. Bodb Derg mac in Dagda, dar fūagra a Tūatha .d.d. ⁊ tāncamar cugat-sa do īarracht feraind ort”.
“Do-gēbthai-si sin, a ócu”, ar rí Érend, “do-bēr-sa cetri trīcha .c. Cenél Conaill dāib”.
ET ro buí in mac robo sine dīb .i. Artrach ⁊ tech n-aighedh coitcend ⁊ fāilti treblīadnach do cech nech ticed and. ET ro baī Ængus ⁊ meic rīgh in tíri ⁊ in
talman ina farrad ic Rāith Mongaigh ⁊ in fer nā faghadh inad in Érend nā in Albain, do-gēibed aici-sium.

Ro buí Æd Éiges ag Lis na nÉices ⁊ clíara Érend ina farrad and ⁊ .x. mblīadna .xx. ro caithset do flaithius Cormaic ūa Chuinn no co fūair bás oc Rāith Spelain a mBredhaib. ⁊ tāncadar-sum ar cúla doridisi co Tūatha .d.d. ⁊ robo lis ablach crandcæm in lis-sa co cnōib cendcorcra caille ⁊ co n-ublaib áille odhurbuidhi ⁊ co n-imat toraid ⁊ maithiusa archena’.
Cid Rāith Rūagh anúigh hī? Caīlte cecinit:
gér’ bo rāith óg ór ablaigh
An cloc ūt atūaig don lis
si Ráith Mongaigh in mór slūaigh
co trāth ērghid na mōr meic
co nach creiti cach ro rēidh. IS ráith’.
‘An cloch fā fuil ant ór ⁊ int airget robo maith lind a faghāil, a Caílte’, ar Conall.
‘Ní hí in cloch is doiligh d’faghbāil itir’, ar Caílte, ‘acht a tabairt a talmain’.
‘Ní hed is doilgid’, ar Conall Derg mac Nēill, ‘acht ērghid cetri .c. fer narmach dā tabairt a talmain’.

⁊ is andsin ro fácaib in cloch lésa mōra ara lámaib mar do scarsatar ría ⁊ nír fétsat a becc d’oscuchad cid ō n-uillind d’araile ⁊ tuc Caílte saghud dā sleigh fūithi cor’ tócaib dā háit ⁊ dā hinad hí. ⁊ tuc Caílte a lāim anund fan cloich ⁊ tucustar līa Find meic Cumaill assa raibi trī .l. uingi d’airget ⁊ trī .l. uingi do dergór ⁊ trī .l. slabrad n-órdaighi ⁊ tuc cloigem catha as ⁊ ro íagh Caílte in cloch īarsin.
‘Maith a anum, a Caīlte’, ar Conall, ‘roind na seōid’.
‘Roindfet’, ar Caílte. ‘IN cloigem ⁊ in slabrad duit-siu ⁊ in līa dergóir do næm Pādraic ūair is é lía creidim ⁊ irisi na nGædel’.
‘Adraé búaid ⁊ bennachtain a Caílte, is maith in senchus ro indisis dūinn’.
IS andsin ro fīarfaig Conall Derg mac Nēill do Caīlte:

‘Filet trī tulca acaind andso ⁊ ní fuil a fis ac sin nō ac sēnoir crēd da filet Lecht na Lǣchraidi ainm tulcha dīb, ⁊ Tulach in Bancuiri ainm tulcha ele, ⁊ Lecht na Macraidi ainm tulcha ele fōs ⁊ tibra asin tres tulaigh dīb ⁊ aband aisti amach ⁊ Glaisi na Fer a hainm sin’.

‘Do gébusa a fis sin’, ar Caílte. ‘Cíngob inand in ní dīa tāit .i. ben tucustar Find .i. Sadb ingen Buidb Deirg. ⁊ ro sirestar coibthi anécéillidhi arin flaith ar Find .i. leth feisi ⁊ leth édála do tobairt di, ūair dq sirthea in doman uile ní fuigthea and ben ba ferr inā in ben sin. Ro shir in coibchi ar Find mac Cumaill ūair nír mó nā írna arna leghad a tenidh delb cech mná ina farrad, ūair ní raibi in Érind nā in Albain fer bud ferr inā Find. ⁊ ro snaidmed dó hí ac Sīdh ar Emher risi rāiter Sīdh Ban Find isin tan-sa.

⁊ arna snaidmed dó, is andsin do-cuaid Find ar slicht lorg Claindi Mornda ro bí ar foghail ⁊ ar diberg fair. ⁊ ro bātar blíadain ar foghail air no co tāncatar conice an rāith sea .i. Rāith Artraigh. Ar sin ro gabadh sosad ⁊ longport oc Find mac Cumaill andso. ⁊ is andsin ro ráidh Find re Ferdomon mac Buidb Derg meic in Dagda, fria brathair na hingine:

“Bud fada le Saidb ingen Buidb Deirg ⁊ a-déra is éislind tucus-
a uirri re blīadain anosa ⁊ fesa ⁊ techta is cōir dam-sa do chur ara cend, a fher
domain”, ar Find. “⁊ cīa is cōir dam-sa do cur ara cenn, a fer domhain?”.

“A cetri derb comdalta fēin atāit annso .i. Conaing ⁊ Cathal dā mac Duib meic Ængusa Tirigh, dā mac rīgh Muman ⁊ a dhá domdalta ele .i. Cathal ⁊ Crimthan dā mac Cuindcétaigh, dā mac rīgh Laighen ⁊ is īat sin dīas is andsa ⁊ is dile ⁊ is dochu lé in Érind”.
⁊ in trāth ’na bīdh ben na banchéile a lepaidh Find meic Cumaill, is īat sin ro bí’, ar Caīlte.
‘“⁊ cīa ūaib, a firu”, ar Find, “rachus ara cend súd?”.
“Rachmait-ne and”, ar sīat, “dā mac rīgh Muman, ūair isnar crīch atā ⁊ is ī is dile ⁊ is dochu lind do mnaib in domain”.

⁊ tāncatar isin rompu cetri .c. con ⁊ cetri .c. gilla ⁊ cetri .c. óclaigh co Sīdh ar Emher risi n-abar Sīdh Ban Find isin tan-sa. ⁊ tāngatar isin sīdh solus mór ⁊ ro ferad fīrchain fāilti rompu cen meirg cen mebail, ⁊ tucad núa cecha bidh ⁊ sen cecha lenda dōib re teora lá ⁊ re teóra aidchi. ⁊ ro tircanatar an āil ⁊ in
“Maith a anum, a ingen”, ar sīat, “is ar do cend-sa tāncamar-ne ō Find mac Cumaill”.
“Crēd fuil and?”, ar in ingen, “acht dul andsin”.

IS andsin ro gabsat-sum a n-errad ⁊ a n-édach umpu trī .c. ingen rīgh ⁊ rīghan, co soine édaigh cecha datha itir brecc ⁊ glas ⁊ gorm ⁊ corcra ⁊ buidhi ⁊ ūaine. ⁊ do rīachtadar conice in tulaigh tǣb ālaind togaidi sea ⁊ ro scuirit a n-eich ⁊ a n-echrada ⁊ ro cuirit a fidletrenda fosta fūithib cor’ geltadar fér barrglas barrūaine co grian ⁊ co grindell ⁊ co leccoib loma. ⁊ is andsin ro gab tart n-íta an ingen ⁊ an findbandtracht uile a haithle na ndīrma.
“Noch n-aithnidh dam uisci a comfocraib annso”, ar Conaing mac Duib meic Ængusa Tírigh ⁊ rīgh líagh cloichi ro bī a mullach na tulcha tondglaisi.
⁊ ro ērgetar in lín fer ro bātar ⁊ tucatar a talmain hí ⁊ ro mebaid in lochtobur ngrindi ngloinidi a bun in cairthi anís.
“IS feramar ro tócbad ant uisci”, ar an ingen, “⁊ cā ferr ainm da mbia uirri nā Glaisi na Fer?”.
⁊ ebait sin a lordothain don uisci ár sin.
“ET dāla Find, ro gellsabair annso, a macu”, ar in ingen.
“Dar mo brēithir āmh, is annso do gellustar beith”, ar sīat.

⁊ do-cuaid a ndegaid Claindi Mornda a cóiciud ollbādhach Ulad budh tūaidh co Bendaib Boirchi. ⁊ ní himcīan ro bātar and co facatar an lūathgrindi áigh ⁊ irghaile atūaidh cech ndīrech hi raibi ocht .xx. fer óclach.
“IN aithintí-si síud?” ar Sadb ingen Buidb Deirg.
“Aithnigemait”, ar īat-son, “.i. Goll mōrglondach mac Mornda dār ndīanmarbad-ne in lín atāmait”.
⁊ ro ērgetar na fir ⁊ ro hindled a carbait ⁊ ro cuirset Sadb ina carpat.

“IN aithinti na firu úd?”,
ar Goll mac Mornda.
“Aithnighemait immorro”, ar Conán, “dā mac Duib meic Ængusa Tírigh, dā mac rīgh Muman ⁊ dā derbfer grāda Find meic Cumaill iter Albain ⁊ Érind”.

IS annsin tucsat muinter Find glún re gail ⁊ re gaisced do Goll mac Mornda ⁊ ro dībraic cách a céile dīb do soighdib sithgorma ⁊ do beraib birgéra ⁊ do laighnib letanglasa lánmóra. ⁊ do rochratar cetri .c. fer n-armach n-incomlaind do macaib Mornda le muintir Find meic Cumaill ⁊ do rochratur-sun cen nech n-élōdhach a mbethaid dīb.
ET dāla an bancuiri, tucsat in aighthi re talmain ⁊ fūaradar bás ⁊ oighidh do ūathfās and, co rob de atā Tulach an Bancuiri arin tulaigh-sea’, ar Caīlti.

‘IS andsin do rīacht Find ⁊ trī catha na fēindi conice seo in lecht laighi ban ⁊ fer arna toitim dā muintir. ⁊ dāla dá mac rīgh Laighen .i. Cuind Cédaigh ⁊ Crimtain, tāngatar do lethlāim Find amach ⁊ tucsat a mbeōil risin tulaigh tǣbālaind togaidhi ⁊ fūaradar bás ann do chuma a dā comdalta.
⁊ do condaic an flaith Find sin ⁊ ro tuitset a airm asa lāim ⁊ ro tuit a sciath da muin ⁊ a cloigem da braigid ⁊ ro caí Finn ⁊ ro caíetar fīanda Érend arcena co falcmur fīrtrūagh.

“IS mairg”, ar Find, “ro soised co tech Cuind Cétaigh co Sīdh Lemna Lendcaime ⁊ is olc in scél indestar do Dub mac Ængusa Tirigh do rí Muman co Cathair Slēibi Claire. ⁊ is olc in scél ro sīa co Bodb Derg mac in Dagda co Sīd Ban Find uodes .i. bás Ainghine do indisin dó”.

Ro érigh Find arsin ⁊ ro cuired na cetri .c. sin do muintir Find fa fochluidib talman ⁊ is amlaid do geibtea cech fer do muintir Find ⁊ fer do macaib Mornda marb fæ. Ro scrībad in ainm oghaim osa cind ⁊ ro ferad a cluithi cainti ⁊ ro tócbad a lía londerda osa cendaib co rob de sin atā Cnocc na Læchraidi arin cnocsa ⁊ Cnocc in Bancuiri arin cnoc ele seo ⁊ Ard na Macraidi arin cnoc sa tūaidh, do macaib rīgh Laigen ro cuired fo talmain and. Co rob ē sin, a Conaill’, ar Caílte, ‘adbar na scél dim’.
IS annsin ro fīarfaig Conall do Caílte:
‘In rabatar gessa ar Find mac Cumaill?”.
‘Nírb’ imda air īat’, ar Caīlte, ‘⁊ ní hīat táinig ris ⁊ ro gabustar crith ⁊ uroman in flaith Find’, ar Caīlte, ‘a haithli a muintiri do cur fo talmain. Find cecinit’.
1. ‘“IS fūar in gnīm dā mac Duib
’s dā mac in rígh a Mumain
2. IS mōr in scél a Ráith Artraigh
bud é in tobur suthain sen
bud irdraicc ic cāch in scél
méraidh co brāch in bith lén.
4. Gan imthecht maitne i mbóin mbred
cen feis adaigh ac Dún Ræch
5. Gan feis re hinghin mBuidb nDeirg
d’ulc nā do maith, comall nglē
is ro brís mo craidi ar trī
is ro chuir mo nert ar nefní.
a comtrūagh sin re hēnūair. IS”’.
‘Adrae búaid ⁊ bennachtain a anum, a Caīlte’, ar Conall, ‘is mōr in fis ro fásais acaind ⁊ ocar n-ughdaraib re indisin do lucht deridh aimsire’.
⁊ tāncatar isin mbaile ⁊ ro bātar ann in aidchi sin.
IS andsin ro érigh Caílte ⁊ ro timāin celebrad do Conall Derg mac Nēill ⁊ do maithib tūaisceirt Érend …e.
‘IS mithigh dam-sa imtecht leth naill festa’.

… a míc reme sair co Loch Doim Derg a nDáil Araidi an lā sin re fuired n-éll~ na nóna, āit a rabadar dā cruimthir ūaisle do muintir næm Pātraic .i. Colmān Eala ⁊ Eoghanān ⁊ sīat oc gabāil na canēine caime coimdeta ⁊ oc etarmolad in Dūileman ⁊ an fīrDīa forōrda and.
IS andsin tāncatar trī meic ecalsa da muintir a curach amach do gabāil ēisc ⁊ sīat oc dēnam a trātha mar do-rōnsat na meic ecalsa ele. ⁊ it-condcatar Caīlte. ⁊ it-condaic Caílte īat.
‘A fir fīa forōrda’, ar sē, ‘is mór ’n ingnad it-condcus ⁊ ní mō nā pend risi tairised sin’, ar sē.

⁊ dordān deghban ⁊ na fēindi it-cluin ind sea andsin ūair ruidb arna roguin ⁊ mná re gúiri lāmna ⁊ mílid maithi menmnacha arna lūath letrada, ro coideoldais risin ceōl do nídís findbandtracht na fēindi and. Caīlte cecinit:
ba minca lim ro baī tan
is trūagh mo marthain i bus
Mall mo turus ō Trāigh Lí
a n-ēistecht lim ba handum. Ba’.
IS andsin táinic Colmān Eala amach ⁊ Eoghanān ⁊ it-concatar na fir ⁊ na coin.

‘Is fīr’, ar Colmān, ‘Caīlti mac Rōnāin siūt do muintir Find meic Cumaill ⁊ do deired na fēindi ⁊ ethar da n-indsaigid’, ar Colmān, ‘ūair do muintir næm Pātraic dōib ⁊ tabartar isin oilén dar n-indsaigid īat’.

⁊ tucad a tech ndīamair nderrit ndeghdaingen īat ⁊ ro freslad ⁊ ro frithōilad co maith īat ⁊ tucad sen cecha lenda ⁊ nūa cecha bīd dōib ⁊ ō tairrnic dōib a proind ⁊ a tomoltus, ro fīarfaig Colmān do Caílte:
‘Crēd ’ma tucad Loch Doim Derg arin loch-sa?’.
Fregras Caīlte co comnart in ceist sin ōir do bī a fis aigi .i.:

‘Dam derg ro buī a lergaib na Lūachra lānbrāenaigh thes ⁊ tēighed do conaib ⁊ d’feraib na fēindi fecht fo trī cecha blīadna ⁊ ro lēnsatar an fīan é blīadain ann ō talergaib na Lūachra conici seo. ⁊ tārthamair-ne cetrar don fēind fair .i. Dīarmait ūa Duibne ⁊ Mac Lughach lāméchtach
⁊ Glas mac Æncerda Berri ⁊ misi ba nesa dō’, ar Caílte, ‘oc tīachtain dochum in locha línidhi lind fūair sea. ⁊ is ann ro dībraic-sium na cetri slegha semnecha slemna so dībraicti a n-ǣnfecht da indsaigid ⁊ do-rochair lind amlaid sin é ⁊ tarrus-sa in dara congna de ⁊ tarraidh Dīarmait an congna aile ⁊ ruc leis hé co Temair Lūachra d’indsaigid Find meic Cumaill. ⁊ tuc Find bun in congna ara
troigthib ⁊ an bend ūachtarach de ara baithis ⁊ is ē ōclach ba mó do Gædelaib é ⁊ in congna ele imorro’, ar Caílte, ‘ro facus a cind na hindsi andso ⁊ is dōigh co mbéraind eōlus da indsaigid’.
‘IS ē seo Loch in Daim Deirg
bud é a ainm ō sin amach
ba maith ar lūth ar gach loch
no co rāngamar ’sa loch. Is é.’
‘Adrae būaid ⁊ bennachtain’, ar Colmān, ‘is mōr in fis ⁊ in fīreōlus sin do fācais acaind’.
‘⁊ fécha let, a meic ecalsa’, ar Caīlte, ‘nar’ ērigh int ésca ina pupaill ærda fós’.
‘Ro érigh’, ar in mac ecalsa, ‘conid solus muir ⁊ tír de’.

IS annsin ro érigh Caílte docum na cúile īarturaigh ro baī isin oilén ⁊ tuc a lāim sís isin brūach ⁊ abail a tuc sāthud sétrech sīrcalma iter tul na tuindi tulguirme ⁊ in brūach .c. mblīadna reme sin ⁊ tuc leis anund co lǣchlār in tighi ara bātar na clērigh cor lín ō airidin co hurlár. ⁊ is ē ba rí Ulad in tan sin .i. Eochaid Fæburderg mac Fírglindi ⁊ is and ro baī a dūnad ⁊ a deghbaile ac Tulaigh Arm risi rāiter Madh Rath isin tan-sa.

IS andsin ro érigh Colmān ⁊ Eoghanān co moch arnamārach seisiur mac n-ecalsa ⁊ rucsat in congna leo dā taispēnad d’Eochaid Fæburderg mac Fírglindi, do rí Ulad. ⁊ is and do bī Ulaid, .xxx. fer óglach ar lár a dūnaidh ⁊ a deghbaile fēin ⁊ tucsat na meic ecalsa in congna do rí Ulad ⁊ do toillfidis .x.c. fer n-armach n-incomloind fæ re dertan ⁊ re doininn.
‘Cīa fūair in congna ⁊ cāit a frith?’, ar rí Ulad.
‘I lLoch Doim Derg thīar fūair Caīlte mac Rōnāin é’.
‘Mochen dam-sa’, ar sē, ‘da toirsed dom’ indsaigid ūair do fuicfed coicrīch cecha feraind ⁊ cecha cnuic ⁊ cecha céti ⁊ iter delugad cecha fine ⁊ cecha tūaithi’.
Dāla na clēirech, tāncatar docum a tighi fēin ⁊ ro fācsat in congna oc rí Ulad.
‘Maith a anum, a Colmāin’, ar Caīlte, ‘crēd adbar na n-ocht trāth ūd dochum in ērghidh iter lá ⁊ aidhci?’.
‘Mōr in āil ⁊ a fātha ⁊ in adbar’, ar in clēirech, ‘.i. ocht caire atā ac lenmain cuirp ⁊ anma cech ēnduine ⁊ dīlait na hocht trātha na hocht caire’.

‘Adrae būaid ⁊ bennachtain a anum, a Colmāin Ela’, ar Caīlte, ‘is maith ro fūaslaigis in cest sin ⁊ cid dam-sa’, ar Caílte, ‘gan na hocht trātha sin do ātaigidh ūair do-fuirigh Rí Nime ⁊ Talman mé’, ar sē, ‘a colaind ⁊ a comré ⁊ a comaimsir riu?’.
IS andsin ro fīarfaig Colmān Ela do Caílte:
‘Crēd ’ma n-abar Tibra in Bandtrochta risin tibrait sea a cind in locha lind fūair?’.

‘Niam ingen Ængusa Tírigh, ingen rīg dā cōiced Muman aníar, táinig conige in tibrait sea ⁊ ro bī Oisīn ann ina farrad re cāicīs ar mís ac dēnam tshelga ⁊ fīadaigh coicidh Ulad ann. ⁊ ticed an ingen .xxx. ban cecha maitne do indlad a lām ⁊ do níamaidh a gnūisi asin uisci eochargorm fīrūaine.

Dāla immorro Ængusa Tīrigh rīgh Muman, ro cuir air co mór a ingen do dul le hOisīn ar athadh ⁊ ar élógh. ⁊ do rinded tinól dā cōiced Muman leis .u. catha com-mōra ⁊ .x.c. ar .xx.c. cecha catha ⁊ tāncatar a n-íarmóracht Find ⁊ na féindi ⁊ Oisīn conici in tibrait sea. ⁊ is sin ǣs ⁊ ūair táinic Níam ingen Ængusa Tírigh docum na tiprat ⁊ ro baī oc indladh a glacc ⁊ ac cur uisci imma gnūis rīghda ruithenta ocin tibrait. ⁊ oc ērgid don ingen ōn tipraith it-condaic na .u. catha arin tulaigh togaidhi taitnemaigh ōsa cind.
“Trūagh sin”, ar sī, “⁊ mogēnar do-gébad bás su it-cifed a oidi ⁊ a athair ⁊ a trī brāithri ⁊ maithi dā cóiced Muman mé”, ar sī.

IS andsin tuc an ingen a gnūis rīgda fri lár ⁊ fūair bās ann in .xxx. findban ro baī ⁊ ro cuirset fuil a craidi tara mbēlaib amach co rob Cnocc in Áir a ainm ō sin anall ⁊ Tibra in Bancuiri ainm na tibrat’.
Cnocc in Áir ō sin alē
‘At-condcatar dā cóiced Muman bás d’fádhba don ingen amlaid sin.

“Is olcc amus Find ⁊ na fēindi ⁊ Oisīn orm-sa”, ar rí Muman, “rucsat mh’ingen ūaim ⁊ fūair bás do nāire acco. ⁊ ērgidh-si dam-sa co Slīab Cind Con i Fāil itá Find ⁊ fūacarthar cath ūaim-si air an ícc mh’ingine tucsat leo”.

IS andsin a-dubairt Ængus Tīrech rí Muman fria banechlaigh dā muintir .i. Moirend ingen Muirisci ⁊ ráinic an banechlach roimpi co Rāith Cind Con a nDāil Araidhi co hairm a raibi Find ⁊ sē oc frasad ⁊ ic fath imbirt na fithcilli ⁊ meic a .i~ca. .i. Osgur mac Oisīn. ⁊ fochtaigh in rí scēla di ⁊ ro indis an echlach a toisc ⁊ at-bert:
is tidhecht leis co Cenn Con
cath ar do shelba a Find. Cath”.
“Andam leisin féind”, ar Find, “cath d’fogra orra do nech ⁊ ērigh amach, a Garb Cronāin”, ar Find, “⁊ abair risin féin ērghid athlum ænfir docum in catha”.
⁊ táinic Garb Cronān amach co longport na fēindi ⁊ ro frecratar an fīan sin ūair tucsat aithne air co raibi mōrsothbifir aigi.

IS annsin ro ērghetar an fīann in ndornchuraib a cloigem trom tortbuillech ⁊ a slegh seimnech snasta slemoncrūaid ⁊ acu salaib a scīath mbreccrendach rētlannach. ⁊ ro cōraighed cath fīrālaind fīrétrocht Find mac Cumaill ⁊ ro cōirighed
a1] amdubach do scīathaib dīsle delighti dondcorcra ina n-urtimcell amuigh anechtair ⁊ fid nemed do sleghaib ūrarda orchrai re gelgūailib dōib ⁊ roba loch ar leithi ⁊ roba catair ar cruindi ⁊ robo dún ditoghlaighi ar daingne in cath sin Find mac Cumaill.
“Maith a anum a rīg fēindigh”, ar in fīan, “caidhi adbar in catha-sa?”.
IS andsin a-dubairt Fergus Finbel filed na fēindi re Find:
“Is cath ectaidhi duit-si in cath sa do tobairt do rí Muman i falaidh a ingine is marb agut”.
IS andsin ro línad lāthair ⁊ ro cenglad comairle ag ocht .xx. fer ōclach do muintir Find ar fót scrútain gāisi risin cath amuich anechtair. IS andsin a-dubairt an flaith Find:
“Cāit a fuil Smírgat ingen Athaidh Étūalaing?”

⁊ ro gabustar a léne do slemainsída buidi fria cnes ⁊ inar mæthshroill tairrsi anechtair cona uchtclār órdhaigi ann co ngab~ ōn gūalaind co cēile di. ⁊ do luid Smírgat ingen Athaidh Ētūalaing roim co hÆngus Tírech ⁊ co maithibh dā cōiced Muman ⁊ it-bert:
“Do béra Find breth Cormaic ūa Cuind rīgh Érend ⁊ Cithrūagh mac Fīrcóicat ⁊ Eithne Ollomda ingen Cathair Móir duit”.
“Dā tuctur cur ⁊ tend ⁊ trebaire risin mbreith sin dam-sa”, ar rí Muman, “gēbat hí”.
“Mac an fir do-roine olc rim”, ar rí Muman, “.i. Oscur mac Oisīn, ⁊ Ferdoman mac Buidb Deirg meic in Dagda ⁊ Dīarmait mac Duinn meic Donncada meic Dubain meic Duibaidchi d’feraib Muman andes”.
IS andsin ro hindised d’Find sin.

⁊ do cūatar an fīan rompu co Temraigh ⁊ rí Muman ⁊ tucad breth Cormaic ⁊ Cithrūagh ⁊ Eithne dōib ⁊ is ī breth rucsat an ingen: do tobairt asin tulaigh toghaidhi a raibi ⁊ a cur a comtrom ⁊ a comtrom d’ór ⁊ a comtrom d’airget ana haiged ⁊ sin do tobairt an éric a ingine do rí Muman ⁊ éric ar leith in cach ingin rīgh ⁊ táisigh do rochair and.
“Cindus roindfēmait in ēric út a fīana Érend?”
“Roindfímait”, ar Cormac, “a leth ar Clánnaib Baīscne ⁊ a leth ara fēind ō sin amach”.

Co ro bī sin’, ar sē Caílte, ‘cét éric ro ícustar Find ⁊ an fīann rīam ⁊ is ī sin, a clérigh, an fochaind a ráta Cnoc in Áir arin cnoc ⁊ Tibra in Banntrachta arin tibrait, ⁊ is ē sin in scēl ro shiris orum’.

IS andsin ro cuir Eochaid Fæburderg rí Ulad fesa ⁊ techta ar cend Caīlte co Rāith Áine i cōiced Ulad ⁊ do rīachtadar na techta sin co Loch Doim Derg ar cend Caílte. Do timain Caīlte celebrad do Colmān ⁊ d’Eoganān ⁊ gellsat na clērigh nem dō-sum ⁊ a ēcnairc do gagāil ⁊ Rí Nime do guidi fair. ⁊ dāla Caīlte, do luid a carbat rīg Ulad āit a raibe Eochaid Fæburderg mac Fírglindi ⁊ ba rí ūasal oirdnighi in rí ro baī andsin .i. ní airged duine ⁊ ní boined a bunad cenēl do nech.

IS andsin ro bī Eochaid Fæburderg mac Fírglindi ⁊ trī catha commōra a n‑ēninad ⁊ .x.c. ar .xx.c. cecha catha dīb. IS andsin do rīacht Caílte da n-indsaigid ⁊ at-racht rí Ulad ⁊ ferais
b1] fāilti fris ⁊ fersat Ulad uili.
‘Maith a anum a Caílte, cā ferr … dūind ní da fíarfochamais dít na senchas na rāth… sa .i. Rāith Áine?’.
‘Fil acum-sa sin in ní dia tá .i. Áine ingen Moghduirnd, ingen rīgh Alban anall. ⁊ ro bātar fir Alban aca radha:
“Cid duit, a rīghan, cen feis le fer… nā le ferchēile?”.
“Ní faghaim-sea in Érend nā in Albain fer… risa dingmála lem feis acht ǣnfer nā má cia… in fer sin” ar Mogdornd, ar athair na hingine.
“Find mac Cumaill”, ar sī, “ant-í oca tá fīana Érend ⁊ fīana Alban”.
⁊ it clo… d’Find sin. IS annsin a-dubairt Find re Find Fer in camp… ⁊ re Rónan rīgh ōclach .i. dā rīgh fēindi fīann Alban…, dola dā togha ⁊ dā tochmarc sin.
“Cā coma bud mait línd di?” ar na hōclaigh.
“Comus a fuil a nĒrind ⁊ i nAlbain acum-sa di ⁊ gan a lēgōn tria bithu”.
“Maith a rīgh fen…”, ar īat-sum, “dias grāda dot muinter bunaid-si lind cu rob mōidi creitfis in rīgan a togha ⁊ a tochmarc duit”.
“Ēirigh-siu a Meic Lugach and sūt ⁊ a Caīlti”, ar Find, “⁊ cid becc mōr gabtais-si oraib di, do-bēr-sa di é…”.

IS andsin lodmar romaind in cetrar fer óglach sin conar fīanaib co Dun Mōr Monaith… i nAlbain ⁊ rucad a tech ndīamar nderrit nded… daingen sind ⁊ ro freslad ⁊ ro frithoiled co maith sind ann. IS andsin do rīacht Mogdornn rí Alban ⁊ a ingen dar n-indsaigid .i. Áine ⁊ ro fīarfaigetar ar fecht ⁊ ar turus dínd ⁊ ro indsemar ar n-āil ⁊ ar n-aithesc.
“At-cluiníd siūt, a ingen”, ar Mogdorn, “at-cluinim aran ingen ⁊ ot-cluinim co rob é siūt fear is ferr a nÉrind ⁊ i nAlbain”.

INa degaid sin ro snaidmed an ben sin d’Find mac Cumaill ⁊ cech ní ro sīr sī ar Find a tabairt di ⁊ tāncamair-ne ⁊ an ingen lind co n-ilar cecha maitius alé docum na rātha sa itāmait ⁊ do rīacht Find trī catha na fēindi inar coinde ⁊ in comdāil ō Temair Lūacra conice seo. ⁊ do rigne Find dūnad ⁊ dingnad ⁊ deghbaile ⁊ tigi rindradarcacha ⁊ grīana na gloinidi ⁊ sondaighi sitharda. ⁊ Cid is ī ro baighidhi and is ī robo muinter ar torachtain ūair is ī ro frestail ⁊ do frithōil sind re blīadain trī catha na féindi can uiresbaid bid nā lenda oraind risin ré sin. A cind blīadna immorro, a-dubairt Mac Lughach risin flaith, re Find:
“Is lōr let-sa do crīch ⁊ d’forba ⁊ d’ferand .i. Áine ingen Mogduirnd”.
“Dar mo brēithir āmh, a Meic Lughach”, ar Find, “ní fedar-sa cā ní do shīrsind i nÉrind nā i nAlbain acht in ní do geibim a tigh Áine”.
⁊ baī in rīgan co cend .uíí. mbliadain ina degaid sin ac Find ⁊ fa buidech fir Erend ⁊ Alban di risin ⁊ ruc dā mac d’Find .i. Uillend Fæburderg ⁊ Æd Becc ⁊ marb issi do breith Æda Bicc mac Find’.
Ferr in ben inā cech ben
cu rob folum in baile. Folum’.
‘Et ro cuired fa fochluidib talman í andso’, ar Caílte, ‘⁊ ro tócbad a líagh loinderda ⁊ ro ferad a cluithi caīntech ⁊ ro scrībad a hainm oghaim’.
‘Adrae būaid ⁊ bennachtain a anum a Caílte’, ar rí Ulad, ‘is maith in scēl ro indisis dūind ⁊ scrībthar in scēl úd a tāmlorgaib filed ⁊ a mbrīatraib ollaman’.
